feeds.title: Parkrun Blog
feeds.description: Our blog page shares news archives, motivational blogs, event updates, and more. Parkrun was established in 2012 in the Republic of Ireland with the first running of Malahide Parkrun. We aim to bring Parkrun to any area or community that wants one.

feeds.title: Running in Cork , Ireland
feeds.description: The Running in Cork blog provides information about various road races in Cork City and County. It also includes the current race calendar, race previews, photos, results, and a lot of local, national, and international running-related news items. The Running in Cork site was started back in late 2006. Its original aim was just to provide some information on road races in the Cork region but over time, additional posts with news items of national and international items were added.

feeds.title: Running in Munster , Ireland
feeds.description: This website contains information about some of the road races in the counties of Kerry, Limerick, Clare, Tipperary and Waterford in Munster, Ireland. The Running in Munster site was started back in 2008 for races outside of Cork. For races in Cork, see the Running in Cork website which is the largest athletics website in Munster. That site also contains plenty of national and international news items as well.

feeds.title: Northern Ireland Mountain Running Association
feeds.description: Our page covers all the latest news, events, and happenings from the Northern Ireland Mountain Running Association. This page is run by the Northern Ireland Mountain Running Association. For all those interested in mountain racing in the NIMRA Championship, this will be the place to get all your information.

feeds.title: Pop Up Races News
feeds.description: Our blog shares the latest news and updates regarding our current running events. Pop Up Races founded in 2014 is Ireland's premier chip timing & event management company offering a range of tiered services to help race organizers to promote and event manage their races from operations including online entry to offering experiential extras.

feeds.title: RunIreland.com
feeds.description: RunIreland.com is Ireland's premier running, triathlon, and OCR website that covers running news, the latest local, club events, and national news, event listings, and online entry to races.

feeds.title: Irish Life Dublin Marathon Blog
feeds.description: Our blog page will keep you up-to-date with what's new and what we are doing. Irish Life Dublin Marathon is the 5th largest marathon in Europe. The start of the Dublin Marathon in 1980 is due mainly to the vision of Noel Carroll and his ability to persuade the BHAA to take on his idea.

feeds.title: NI Running
feeds.description: NI Running aims to bring you great content on Northern Ireland Running. Club news, results, race reports, and race announcements for road, cross country, and ultras. A website dedicated to all things running in Northern Ireland! Road, Mountain, Track, Trail, and Cross Country. We endeavor to cover it all.

feeds.title: Marathonkids Ireland News
feeds.description: Our website shares the latest news and updates about Marathon Kids Ireland's upcoming events. Marathon kids Ireland is an 8-week program targeting 5th & 6th Class students in schools in Fingal and Dublin City organized by South Dublin County Council along with Fingal County Council and Dublin City Council.

feeds.title: Diary of a Rubbish Marathon Runner Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Thomas. In this blog, I write about my races and experiences before and after as well me running in the beautiful area of Caragh Lake, Kerry, and more recently in Dublin.
